description: Gares et stations du réseau ferré (par ligne) is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ces données localisent les gares et stations (métro, tramway, RER...) à Issy-les-Moulineaux et dans les alentours. Le jeu de données complet est ici:. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Réseau ferré, Lignes. The portal shows 63 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-05-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
